messages:
ella: Proposal: add 'commit hysteresis' + softcap windows to reduce ping-ponging between tiers when customers spike briefly. Two parts: (A) hysteresis band for tier transitions, (B) softcap buffer that absorbs short-term overages before add-ons kick in. Thoughts? :thinking:

kevin: Love it. quick defs? hysteresis band = require sustained usage X% above/below tier for Y days before moving tier? softcap = a token/dollar buffer that auto-applies to spikes and is billed post-window if still high?

ella: Exactly. My rough defaults: band = 25% sustained for 14 days. softcap = 5% of baseline or 100k tokens, whichever is larger, applied per-billing-entity and resets monthly but measured over a 7d smoothing window for charge triggers.

jyoti: product implications: how does this interact with committed capacity (Dedicated) and Reserved? For Dedicated we'd need an exception because customers pay for reserved chairs, can't auto-demote without contract. Also need explicit opt-in/opt-out controls in Console.

ella: good catch. Proposal: for Dedicated/Reserved, hysteresis is advisory only — sales/legal must approve any tier changes. For Hosted customers it's automatic (with notification). Console toggle default = ON for hosted, OFF for reserved.

kevin: eng notes: implementation sketch: sliding-avg per-customer, state machine for tier status with timestamps. endpoints: `POST /v1/customers/{id}/hysteresis` to read/set overrides, and metric `prometheus:customer_tier_state{customer="C123"}`. Estimated 3 sprints (core logic + churn tests + console UI).

ella: billing flow: charges should be computed against effective tier during invoice period; softcap reconciliation happens during invoice run: if overages are within softcap window, apply buffer and mark for potential billing charge after 7 days; if sustained, convert to add-on line. We'll need secure audit trail for reconciliations.

jyoti: launch criteria suggestion: [1] migration/playbook for flagged customers; [2] Console UI: toggle + visualization of hysteresis window + projection; [3] Billing simulation tool that replays historical usage for last 12 months and shows net delta; [4] legal/compliance signoff for meter semantics; [5] 3 pilot customers (hosted) across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise.

ella: add SLO/regression tests: ensure no change to latency or runtime throttles; softcap must not affect realtime burst logic. Add a smoke test that simulates 3 quick spikes and verifies no tier flip.

kevin: ops question: how surface to customers? recommend daily email when they're within 10% of hysteresis threshold and weekly report if in window. Also Console banner with countdown days until threshold breach.

legal-bot: FYI: any change that affects billing semantics triggers TOS addendum and 45-day notice. Also capture opt-in records for pilots.

jyoti: sales/contracting asks: need an "effective date" field for pilots so customers can model contract impact. Also want a contract clause snippet that clarifies hysteresis behavior for negotiation.

ella: next steps I'm drafting RFC + prototypes of the console visuals. @kevin please stub the metric names and API surfaces. @tom-biz can you surface one enterprise and two SMB pilots? I'll include the launch criteria in the roadmap doc and raise in next PM-sync. :white_check_mark:

kevin: noted. I'll drop a PR with proto API and a small test harness you can run against historical data.

ella: thanks all. label: `pr/hysteresis-softcap-v1` and I'll add to Q3 roadmap backlog.
